videos.title: The Bonnaroo Experience

videos.title: Jon Lajoie (Secret Stash)
videos.overview: Lajoie filmed an episode of Comedy Central Presents on November 7, 2009.  It premiered on March 5, 2010.  The same special aired uncensored as part of Comedy Central's Secret Stash on June 6 featuring the world premiere of the video for his song "Pop Song".
